⚠️ Worst Experience with Trinity Air Travel – Highly Unprofessional Service
I had an extremely disappointing experience with Trinity Air Travel due to poor coordination and rude behavior from staff members Shree and Surya.
Here’s what happened:
I inquired about a flight ticket and was provided with a price.
I confirmed the booking and requested bank details for payment.
Despite receiving multiple payment reminders, no bank details were shared, even after repeated follow-ups.
During working hours, the staff claimed they were busy but continued sending reminders without resolving the issue.
Due to this unnecessary delay and lack of coordination, I had to retrieve the bank details from their previous emails myself.
By the time I checked the flight independently, the ticket price had increased, causing me a direct financial loss.
Throughout the process, the staff’s attitude was rude, uncooperative, and highly unprofessional.
This entire experience was a complete waste of time and caused avoidable stress. Such service standards are unacceptable for a professional travel company. I sincerely hope Trinity Air Travel’s management takes this feedback seriously and improves internal coordination and customer handling.
— Shivam Bansal

featured_reviews.name: ziv izackov
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid This Tour Company – Unreliable and Disorganized!
I booked a two-day tour package in Mumbai and paid in advance. The company was supposed to pick me up at 9:00 AM for a city tour, including the slum areas. They arrived late and sent a driver who did not speak any English. Due to time constraints, they changed the itinerary without informing me and took me to the Elephanta Caves instead.

The drive to the caves took an hour, followed by another 30 minutes of the driver searching for parking—he had no idea where to go. We took a crowded ferry to the caves, where I had to stand for the entire hour-long journey. At the caves, a local guide joined me and provided a decent but unremarkable tour. By the time we finished, it was already 3:30 PM, and I had not eaten anything. I contacted the company via WhatsApp to ask about the next part of the tour but received no response.

We took the ferry back to the Gateway of India, where the driver handed me his phone so I could speak with the guide who was supposed to take me on the city tour. It was already 4:30 PM. The guide told me to wait for him at a café, but neither I nor the driver knew where it was. I waited at a nearby Starbucks for 30 minutes until the guide finally arrived. The city tour started around 5:00 PM and was just average.

At the end of the tour, I got stuck in traffic for nearly two hours, arriving at my hotel around 9:00 PM. For some reason I still don’t understand, the driver refused to let me out of the car at the hotel. Only after I shouted at him did he get startled, unlock the door, and let me go.

The second day of the tour was supposed to start in the late morning or early afternoon. Instead, the guide called and said it would only begin at 5:00 PM. At that point, I had had enough and canceled the rest of the tour.

I strongly advise against booking with this company. Save your money and go with a more reliable provider.

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Saha
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are from Canada and have used J M Mehta travel for our customized 3-week tour of North India in December 2017. This was my wife’s and children’s first trip to India and I wanted to ensure that everything went well. We got quotes from quite a few agencies including the big names like Kesari and Heena Travels from India. J M Mehta was the most competitive offer and HONEST for the exact same itinerary.
Mrs. Tuersey Miranda of J M Mehta did a fantastic job in planning and organizing our trip. She was very prompt and diligent in her responses. She answered every query meticulously and always ready to help. She was always available even with the 10.5 hour of time difference between Canada and India. She even responded immediately to a text message sent late at night when we had an issue at one of the hotels during my trip. The driver she organized- Sumer Singh was very courteous, respectful and very helpful. I am extremely pleased with the great service provided and will use them in future. I have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone looking for a great travel experience in India.

Update October 2022.
Based on my great experience in December 2017 I thought that this travel agency should be my go to travel agent for my next trip that I wanted to take in September 2022. I regret to state things have gone completely downhill now. Mrs. Miranda is no longer with J.M.Mehta Travel and no one gives a damn about customer service anymore. I sent several emails, made multiple overseas calls, even had my sister who lives in Mumbai to call them but I was not even able to solicit any response from this company to my request for a quote for a custom package to Kerala. The query form in their website does not go through neither do the emails to most of the contacts listed in their website. The telephone numbers listed on their website also are sketchy at best. I was finally able to find out the contact details of Nilesh Sharma, Operation Head JMM Travel & Tour Co. I explained to him that I was a returning customer and was very interested in using them again. But sadly nothing worked and I finally decided to move on. It is best to avoid this agency as soliciting even a courtesy response is going to be a wild goose chase. If one as to chase this agency just to give them business then you can imagine how responsive they are going to be once they have your money.
In the meantime I was able to find a great alternative and had a great trip to Kerala. I will be positing my review for that in a few days.
